title: RainfallObservation
description: Standardized schema for a single point-in-time rainfall observation from any weather source (e.g. IMD, local sensor, simulation).

location_id.description: Unique identifier of the weather station, sensor, or road grid location (e.g., 'IMD_DEL_LODHI' or 'LOC_CENTRAL').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC or with timezone offset (e.g., '2026-10-09T10:00:00Z').

rainfall_intensity_mm_hr.description: Rainfall rate in millimeters per hour. Must be non-negative.

is_raining.description: Optional explicit flag indicating active rainfall. If omitted, derived as rainfall_intensity_mm_hr > 0.0.

latitude.description: Latitude of the observation source in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the observation source in decimal degrees.

accumulated_rainfall_mm.description: Optional cumulative rainfall in mm recorded during the observation window.
